title: backlog.py peers lists the other live sessions' plans, files and sprints and names each file a plan shares with them
goal: `backlog.py peers [--sprint SP | --item ID | --touch GLOB...]` lists, read-only and with no model call, every other live Claude session of the clone with its label, topic, items and files from its coord intents, the active and planned sprints on the integration main with their items' files, and the held claims; with a sprint, item or touch it names each file that work shares with them, a shared `kb/_self` doc as `doc` and any other file as `overlap`, exiting 1 when an overlap is found and 0 otherwise; it prints no raw session id and leaves this session's own intents out

run:
import json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time, uuid
if os.name == "nt":
    print("check skipped: the planted live session needs a POSIX host"); sys.exit(0)
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp())
S = os.path.join(T, "coord.sqlite")
base_env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith("GIT_") and k not in ("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID", "KB_COORD_URL")}
base_env.update(KB_COORD_STORE=S, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=os.path.join(T, "cfg"), COLUMNS="200")
A, B = str(uuid.uuid4()), str(uuid.uuid4())
envA = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=A)
envB = dict(base_env, CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID=B)
def sh(*a, cwd=None, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, env=env or base_env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=180)
O = os.path.join(T, "origin.git"); K = os.path.join(T, "clone")
sh("git", "init", "-q", "--bare", "-b", "main", O)
sh("git", "clone", "-q", O, K)
for k, v in (("user.email", "a@example.com"), ("user.name", "n")):
    sh("git", "config", k, v, cwd=K)
shutil.copy(os.path.join(R, "backlog.json"), K); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "backlog"))
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_tools")); os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "kb", "_self", "reports"))
for p in ("_tools/kbtail.py", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "_tools/bench_load.py", "kb/_self/tools.md", "kb/_self/map.csv"):
    with open(os.path.join(K, p), "w") as f:
        f.write("planted\n")
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "base", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
def bl(*a, env=None):
    return sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "backlog.py"), "--root", K, *a, cwd=K, env=env)
def new_id(r):
    m = re.search(r"\b(?:ST|SP)-[a-z0-9]{8}\b", r.stdout)
    if not m:
        print("check broken: backlog.py new printed no id:", r.stdout[-300:], r.stderr[-300:]); sys.exit(2)
    return m.group(0)
# Session B: the session-load benchmark, a planned sprint pushed to main and a live intent (today's replay)
SPb = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "One session's host cost, measured without a model", "--goal", "bench", env=envB))
ITb = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "A no-model session-load benchmark replays one session's hooks", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/bench_load.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md", "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", "--sprint", SPb, env=envB))
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "plan session-load", cwd=K)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
co = lambda *a, env=None: sh(sys.executable, os.path.join(R, "_tools", "coord.py"), "--store", S, *a, env=env)
co("claim", "session/" + B, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", B)
co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + B, "--field", "topic=session-load-benchmark",
   "--field", "touch=_tools/bench_load.py,kb/_self/tools.md,kb/_self/map.csv")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook"), exist_ok=True)
with open(os.path.join(K, "_cache", "coord_hook", B + ".json"), "w") as f:
    json.dump({"items": [], "lease_until": time.time() + 3600, "token": "t"}, f)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(T, "bin")); FAKE = os.path.join(T, "bin", "claude"); os.symlink("/bin/sleep", FAKE)
procB = subprocess.Popen([FAKE, "300"], cwd=K)
# Session A: this session's plan, the live agent view's second slice (shares map.csv and the tools.md doc with B)
co("claim", "session/" + A, "--ttl", "3600", "--holder", A)
SPa = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Live agent view, second slice", "--goal", "view", env=envA))
ITa = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "kbtail.py follows every live session", "--goal", "g",
                "--touch", "_tools/kbtail.py", "--touch", "_tools/mon_sessions.py", "--touch", "kb/_self/tools.md",
                "--touch", "kb/_self/map.csv", env=envA))
# B holds a claim on an item of an active sprint, pushed to main
SPh = new_id(bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "Held work", "--goal", "h", env=envB))
ITh = new_id(bl("new", "story", "--title", "h edits zz", "--goal", "g", "--touch", "_tools/zz.py", "--check", "python3 -c pass", "--sprint", SPh, env=envB))
bl("answer", SPh, "start", "--answer", "approve", "--by", "operator", env=envB); bl("start", SPh, env=envB)
sh("git", "add", ".", cwd=K); sh("git", "commit", "-q", "-m", "start h", cwd=K)
rc = bl("claim", ITh, "--by", "claude-bbbbbbbb", "--commit", env=envB)
sh("git", "push", "-q", "origin", "HEAD:main", cwd=K); sh("git", "fetch", "-q", cwd=K)
def cleanup():
    procB.kill()
problems = []
def need(c, w):
    if not c: problems.append(w)
try:
    co("post", "--kind", "intent", "--field", "session=" + A, "--field", "topic=own-planted-topic", "--field", "touch=_tools/kbtail.py")
    bl("set", ITa, "--sprint", SPa, env=envA)
    r = bl("peers", "--sprint", SPa, env=envA)
    if "invalid choice" in r.stderr or "unrecognized" in r.stderr:
        print("check failed: backlog.py has no peers command"); sys.exit(1)
    out = r.stdout
    need(r.returncode == 1, "peers --sprint with a shared file exits %d, not 1: %s" % (r.returncode, r.stderr[-200:]))
    need("session-load-benchmark" in out, "the live peer's topic is not named")
    need("host cost" in out and ITb in out, "the other session's planned sprint and its item are not named")
    need(any("kb/_self/map.csv" in x and "overlap" in x for x in out.splitlines()), "the shared kb/_self/map.csv is not named as an overlap")
    need(any("kb/_self/tools.md" in x and "doc" in x for x in out.splitlines()), "the shared kb/_self/tools.md is not named as a doc")
    need("own-planted-topic" not in out, "this session's own intent is listed as a peer")
    need(A not in out and B not in out, "a raw session id is printed")
    need(any(ITh in x and ("claim" in x or "held" in x) for x in out.splitlines()), "the held claim on the active sprint's item is not named")
    r2 = bl("peers", "--touch", "_tools/kbtail.py", env=envA)
    need(r2.returncode == 0 and "session-load-benchmark" in r2.stdout and "overlap" not in r2.stdout,
         "peers --touch of a file no peer touches does not exit 0 listing the peers: exit %d %s" % (r2.returncode, r2.stdout[-200:]))
finally:
    cleanup()
print("\n".join(problems) or "ok")
sys.exit(1 if problems else 0)

clauses.clause: `backlog.py peers [--sprint SP | --item ID | --touch GLOB...]` lists, read-only and with no model call, every other live Claude session of the clone with its label, topic, items and files from its coord intents, the active and planned sprints on the integration main with their items' files
with a sprint, item or touch it names each file that work shares with them, a shared `kb/_self` doc as `doc` and any other file as `overlap`, exiting 1 when an overlap is found and 0 otherwise
it prints no raw session id and leaves this session's own intents out

notes: Reuse, no parallel reader: the live sessions come from `mon_sessions.live_sessions(root)` (ST-bngriclp), the intents from `coord.py digest`, the sprints and claims from `bl_view` held and `bl_plan.touches_meet` / `shared_doc`. A shared doc never orders items; it is shown so the planner sees the landing order. kb/_self/map.csv is shared with the session-load benchmark's ST-7nuaruwn (claimed by session c5ef8aa4 on 2026-10-26): this story lands after it, told through a coord ask. Plan check 2026-10-26: the check now also plants a held claim (an active sprint item claimed and pushed) and asks peers to name it, so the clause "the held claims" has its own case. On the base it fails: backlog.py has no peers command (premise reproduced). Moved out of SP-basca7ae by the unattended orchestrator 2026-10-26: the worker ($1.15) raised two gates of class agents-rule (the item touches backlog.py and bl_peers.py): g1 which sessions and plans peers lists besides live processes and main sprints (recommended: also a session with a live lease and intent but no process; leave the work own sprint out), g2 how many holders a shared-file line names (recommended: six, then and N more). They wait on the operator; the work is on branch work/ST-hjl7dhyh.
